items.title: Marico sees sustained growth momentum, raises FY27 margin outlook
items.description: Marico experienced significant revenue and profit growth in the September quarter due to robust demand. The company's foods and premium personal care segments led this growth, supported by reduced input costs. Marico raised its Ebitda margin outlook, anticipating continued strong demand in the future. International business performance is improving in markets such as Vietnam and the Middle East, contributing to overall growth.

items.title: Happiest minds Q2 net profit rises 15% as AI uncertainty weighs
items.description: Happiest Minds Technologies reported a 15.1% increase in net profit for the September quarter compared to the previous year. While revenue grew by 12.5% year-on-year, it reflects ongoing concerns over client decision-making related to artificial intelligence. The company’s managing director noted the challenges of longer sales cycles and uncertain customer investments in AI solutions. Despite a relatively good demand scenario, they are still behind their revenue growth target.

items.title: Arisinfra Solutions reports 110% rise in H1 net profit to Rs 42.9 cr
items.description: Arisinfra Solutions reported a 110% year-on-year rise in H1FY27 net profit to Rs 42.9 crore, with revenue increasing 32% to Rs 598.5 crore. Q2 profit reached a record Rs 22.8 crore, supported by contract manufacturing and DaaS growth.

items.title: BSE Q2 Results: Net profit surges 45% YoY to Rs 809 crore; revenue jumps 34%
items.description: BSE on Wednesday reported a 44.9% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 809.15 crore for the second quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), compared with Rs 558.43 crore in the corresponding period last year (Q2FY26).

items.title: Allcargo Terminals shares jump 12% after Q2 profit surges 86% YoY to Rs 21 crore
items.description: Allcargo Terminals showcased remarkable growth with an 85.8% rise in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27. Operational revenue grew by 22%, affirming its strong financial standing. The EBITDA margin improved to 23.6%, signaling enhanced operational efficacy. During trading, the company's shares surged by 11.71%, reflecting investor confidence. They also provided updates regarding their partly paid-up equity shares in a subsequent announcement.

items.title: Dabur India Q2 Results: Profit rises 12% YoY to Rs 506 crore, revenue up 12%; co declares interim dividend of Rs 3.50/share
items.description: Dabur India reported an 11.7% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 505.5 crore, while revenue grew 11.6% to Rs 3,563.1 crore. Growth was driven by food, beverages, premium brands and international markets.

items.title: Nykaa Q2 Results: PAT soars 207% YoY to Rs 101 crore, revenue up 28%; co to acquire 82% stake in Simply Nam
items.description: Nykaa reported a 207% year-on-year profit surge to Rs 101 crore in Q2FY27, with revenue rising 28% to Rs 3,006 crore. Beauty and fashion businesses accelerated growth, while quick commerce, owned brands and strategic acquisitions strengthened expansion.

items.title: Lenskart Q2 Results: Profit zooms 122% YoY to Rs 227 crore; revenue grows 36%
items.description: Lenskart Solutions achieved a net profit of Rs 227.08 crore in Q2FY27, reflecting a 122.1% YoY increase. Revenue from operations rose to Rs 2,845.03 crore, marking a 35.7% YoY growth. Product margin improved to 64% compared to 63.4% in the same quarter last year. The company added 165 new stores in Q2FY27, enhancing its active store count to 3,624.

items.title: Dr Lal PathLabs posts higher quarterly profit on strong diagnostic test demand
items.description: Dr Lal PathLabs announced a 27% increase in its second-quarter profit, with net earnings rising to 1.92 billion rupees. The company experienced a near 20% increase in consolidated revenue from operations during this period. A rise in healthcare awareness has fueled the demand for preventive health check-ups, contributing to these earnings. Dr Lal tested 13.6% more samples this quarter compared to the previous year.

items.title: Allcargo Logistics Q2 Results: Co posts Rs 19 crore profit; revenue rises 3.4%
items.description: Allcargo Logistics Ltd reported a positive shift in financial performance during the September quarter of FY27, achieving a consolidated profit after tax of Rs 19 crore. This demonstrates a year-on-year growth alongside a 3.4 percent increase in operational revenue. With the festive season on the horizon, the company anticipates further demand, focusing on enhancing capacity utilization and reinstating volume growth in the upcoming months.

items.title: Bayer CropScience Q2 profit rises 9% to Rs 166 crore despite 19% decline in revenue
items.description: Bayer CropScience Ltd has announced an impressive 8.84% growth in net profit, totaling Rs 166.2 crore for Q2 FY27. However, total income saw a 19.4% decline year-over-year, attributed to ongoing market challenges. Factors such as unpredictable monsoon patterns have disrupted both sowing and crop protection demand. In response, the company emphasizes efficiency improvements and portfolio enhancements, while the board has declared an interim dividend of Rs 90 per share.

items.title: Saregama India Q2 net profit jumps over 46% to Rs 64.2 cr, revenue grows 36.6%
items.description: Saregama India has reported an impressive 46.4 percent rise in its consolidated net profit for the September quarter. Alongside this, the company’s operational revenue saw a 36.63 percent increase, with the music segment generating Rs 251.3 crore and live events thriving remarkably. The total income for the first half of FY27 reached Rs 587.28 crore, showcasing solid financial results.

items.title: Titan Company Q2 results preview: Profit may rise up to 27% YoY; jewellery growth, margins in focus
items.description: Titan Company is set to release its financial results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. Brokerage forecasts suggest revenue growth could range from 18.8% to 27% compared to the previous year. Additionally, a substantial year-on-year profit increase of around 27% is anticipated. Key focal points will include jewellery performance, margins, and the growth trajectory of CaratLane, with brokerages recommending a buy on Titan shares due to potential upside.

items.title: Arisinfra Solutions reports 110% rise in H1 net profit to Rs 42.9 cr
items.description: Arisinfra Solutions reported a 110% jump in first-half profit as revenue and operating margins improved. Strong growth in contract manufacturing and its Developer as a Service business helped the company post its highest-ever quarterly profit.
